teaser: Why a sovereign website's model is the owner's choice, and how Mistral fits: Ministral 3 on the device, Mistral Small 4 on an EU endpoint.
core_idea: A site sovereign in its files but tied to one model provider is rented in its brain, so the model becomes the owner's choice behind one OpenAI-style interface, with Mistral as the European option at every level, Apache 2.0 models first, and never the only door.

nodes.label: The licence to watch
nodes.summary: Large 4 needs a licence as a service.

quotes.text: the site is sovereign in its files and rented in its brain.
Mistral as the European default, never the only door.
